what_to_detect: A spell or ability resolves with a blight N cost paid: N -1/-1 counters were put on a creature its controller controls.
near_miss: The same kind of spell or ability resolving with its optional blight cost unpaid.
record_fields: snapshot counters on the blighted creature before the effect half
sidecar script Cost$ part; a cost's counters are not among the effect half's events and the cost half's costs summary has no counter field

what_to_detect: A decision candidate whose cost includes a blight part and is not affordable, because its controller controls no creature to put the counters on.
near_miss: A candidate whose cost includes a blight part and is affordable.

what_to_detect: An ability whose blight cost was paid resolves with its later clause acting on the blighted creature (a token copy of it is created).
near_miss: The same kind of ability whose blight was declined, so the clause referring to the blighted creature does nothing.
